title: Coverage Changes of the Expiring Term and the Renewal Cap — NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
## The rise kept outside the cap (NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own), renewal remittances on tiers without ICC coverage)

**Clause.** The rise kept outside the cap is, when the deductible decrease recorded last took effect during the expiring term, that decrease's full-term risk premium less the risk premium booked for the term at its start; when the coverage increase recorded last took effect during the expiring term and no such deductible decrease did, that increase's full-term risk premium less the risk premium booked for the term at its start; and nothing otherwise. A rise kept outside the cap is taken out of the rated risk premium before the cap is applied and added to the capped amount before the lower figure is taken.

**Reading the records.**
- "Recorded last" means the endorsement of that kind with the latest record date on the policy; "took effect during the expiring term" means its effective date falls on or after the term start and before the term end. An endorsement with no effective date recorded has not taken effect.
- "Full-term risk premium" is the figure the rating engine returned for that endorsement.
- "The risk premium booked for the term at its start" is the risk premium charged for the expiring term at new business or at renewal.

| Deductible decrease recorded last took effect in the expiring term | Coverage increase recorded last took effect in the expiring term | Rise kept outside the cap |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes or no | Decrease's full-term risk premium less the risk premium booked at the term start |
| No | Yes | Increase's full-term risk premium less the risk premium booked at the term start |
| No | No | Nothing |

*Hypothetical case.* Risk premium booked at the term start 1,000.00 dollars; a deductible decrease that took effect mid-term carried a full-term risk premium of 1,100.00, so the rated risk premium now stands at 1,100.00. The rise kept outside the cap is 100.00: the cap applies to 1,000.00 (1,100.00 less 100.00), and 100.00 is added to the capped amount before it is compared with the indicated premium.
